finalists.label: Myocarditis
finalists.why: The candidate has specific evidence including Troponin T elevation, severe left ventricular dysfunction, and ST-segment elevation, which are not fully explained by other candidates.

finalists.label: Cardiomyopathy

frontier_selector.why: Myocarditis is chosen due to its specific findings including recent upper respiratory tract infection symptoms and palpitations, which are directly related to the condition, making it a more precise diagnosis than the broader category of Cardiomyopathy.
